column2: [scoped_guardian.GetFirstName] is such a bore! [scoped_guardian.GetHerHisCap] lessons are tedious and [scoped_guardian.GetSheHe] never lets me play in peace. I think it is time for me to find a better guardian.

[From.GetFirstName] was really insistent about showing me a present [From.GetSheHe] prepared just for me, yet, now that we are alone in [From.GetHerHis] chambers, I do not think following [From.GetHerHim] was such a good idea...
It seems I underestimated [From.GetFirstName]. [From.GetSheHeCap] did not fall for my trick and simply scolded me for trying to get [From.GetHerHim] hurt.

A bit of careful waiting, a few stings in the right places, and, just like that, the game is already over. Well, for [From.GetFirstName], that is. How unfortunate that [From.GetSheHe] will no longer be able to fulfill [From.GetHerHis] duties as my guardian anymore. Perhaps [From.GetHerHis] successor will be kinder to me.

It has been some time since anybody at court saw [scoped_guardian.GetTitledFirstName]. The [scoped_guardian.GetManWoman] seems to have vanished without leaving a trace. [FromFrom.GetFirstName], [scoped_guardian.GetFirstName]'s ward, has been pestering me for quite some time about assigning [FromFrom.GetHerHim] to a new guardian.

My recent victory over the armies of [defeated_emperor.GetTitledFirstName] has resonated across [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName]. Despite all odds I led my people against their hired regiments and the war galleys of their fleet, and brought low the proud house of [defeated_emperor.GetOnlyDynastyName].

column1: Such was my triumph that the folk of the Border Princes have started to compare me to Teuta, the sea-queen of old who raided the merchant fleets of Tilea from her hidden coves and never bent the knee to any prince. Some even whisper that my prowess in this war is proof that her blood runs in my veins.

column2: As if our recent defeat at the hands of [From.GetTitledFirstName] was not humiliation enough, more Border Princes cutthroats are gathering around her banner, emboldened by her success. She has even started to spread ludicrous tales of her descent from Teuta, the pirate sea-queen who plagued the merchant fleets of Tilea in bygone times.

column1: We must clean the stain of this failure from our name before every petty prince on the coast tries the same...

column2: Only through constant practice and innovation can a commander maintain dominance over the battlefield. I must drill my troops regularly if I wish to prevail against my enemies.

All these days spent in the field, shouting orders and hitting things have done wonders to improve my reflexes and endurance, yet they have not been good for my looks. The coarse voice, messy hair and foul stench are making me look more and more like a man than I would like to admit.

Organizing formations with uneducated peasants and unexperienced officers looks like an impossible task at times. How many times can I repeat a very simple strategy before it finally enters the thick mind of my soldiers?

All of this studying, training and discussing strategy has given me very little time to rest or eat. I feel that, if I am not too careful, I might soon become too weak to hold a sword or yell my orders at the troops. I have already taken on a more skeletal look and I am becoming increasingly paler.

Only by improving the relations I have with my fellow noblemen I can ensure peace and prosperity for my people. And there is no better way to do so than by exchanging gifts and organizing a few lavish feasts.

[From.GetTitledFirstName] has dedicated a lot of [From.GetHerHis] time in the past weeks trying to make sure that all [From.GetHerHis] vassals understand the girth of [From.GetHerHis] prestige and generosity, holding several feasts and getting to know each of us better. [From.GetSheHeCap] has undoubtedly proven to be an enthralling [From.GetManWoman]...
I hope you will accept this small gift in exchange for your hospitality and care, my [Root.GetTitle].\n[From.GetTitledFirstName]

Being such a popular public figure is proving to be more vexing than I ever thought possible. The expectations my guests have about me are quite high, and they appear very often to be focused on my appearance more than anything else. Most of the times, they will not even care of what comes out of my mouth, enthralled as they are by my voice.

All these meetings and feasts I organize to keep my subjects and neighbors happy have come with no shortages of toasts to new friendships and a prosperous future. It is always quite inspiring, yet I am not sure how much dignified it is to reach the end of every night as a giggling goose.

All these visits, feasts and celebrations are giving me endless new opportunities to further refine my palate with all sorts of exotic foods, and I fear that if I do not watch myself, the graceful figure I was blessed with will soon be a long-lost memory, as the paunch tightly pressing my dress can already attest.

All my informers are ready to relay my orders throughout [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName], using bribery and intimidation to prevent my subjects from conspiring against me and putting the realm's peace under threat.

The vile spies sworn to the [From.GetOnlyDynastyName] dynasty have been unleashed once more upon [From.PrimaryTitle.GetName]. Recent rumors have convinced the [From.GetTitle] that somebody might be conspiring against [From.GetHerHim] and, as has become tradition for some time now, [From.GetTitledFirstName] has sent [From.GetHerHis] cronies to pressure all of [From.GetHerHis] subjects into submission.

Peace is not easily ensured upon the unruly masses. Even now, my vassals keep conspiring within the inscrutable depths of their thoughts, where my spies cannot reach them. If I wish to find proof to frame them, I must be vigilant. Every cowardly twitch and bashful gaze around me betrays their treasonous hearts.

More naive rulers might claim that stability and prosperity in government is achieved through an open relation of mutual trust between a liege and [Root.GetHerHis] vassals, yet nothing could be further from the truth. To give my subjects any reprieve from scrutiny would only invite insubordination and chaos.

It is my sworn duty to uphold the peace over [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName]. In order to do so, I must crush any form of organized resistance coming from my rebellious subjects. Hardening my heart against their entitled demands is something that I do for their own good.

I worry about [meddling_target.GetFirstName]. If [meddling_target.GetSheHe] is going to represent the prestigious [Root.GetOnlyDynastyName] name, [meddling_target.GetHerHis] bearing and behavior should be impeccable.

My [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName] decided to visit me last night. [From.GetSheHeCap] has been concerned with my health as of late, and wanted to remind me that [From.GetSheHe] is always going to be ready to support me, and so is the rest of our family.

I have just received a long, stern chiding from my [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName] about my current conduct. [From.GetSheHeCap] has berated me for surrendering to vice and apathy in such a way as to bring dishonor to our prestigious family name, and urged me to change my attitude immediately.

My [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName] has decided to give me a long talk about the virtues and responsibilities of a good [Root.GetManWoman] towards [Root.GetHerHis] family, about the necessity to remain faithful to one's spouse, build a relationship based on trust and respect, and, most importantly, maintain the bloodline going with new heirs.

According to [From.GetHerHim], only by embracing this culture I will be able to set good morals for my descendants to follow.

My [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName] believes that I spend too much time worrying about my looks and not enough studying and tending to my responsibilities as a [Root.GetTitle], that I am wasting my youth as a vacuous fop and I will come to regret it in time.

My [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName] believes that I do not spend enough time taking care of my image, that it is extremely important for a young [Root.GetManWoman] of my stature to always appear at my best before my subjects. [From.GetSheHeCap] insists that by neglecting myself I smear my family's good name.

My [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName] has been encouraging me for some time now to try and eat more, fearing that my frugal diet might cause me to get seriously sick, and that my frail disposition might reflect badly on our family's prestige.

My [GetFromRelation] [From.GetFirstName] has been encouraging me for some time now to try and eat less, fearing that immoderation in my diet might cause me to get seriously sick and, more importantly, that it might put a stain on our family's good name.

My [GetFromRelation] has heeded my call and finally embraced [From.Culture.GetName] customs. My [GetFromRelation] refused to follow my advice and is still spending an undue amount of time grooming [From.GetHerselfHimself] while neglecting some of [From.GetHerHis] responsibilities. Following my advice, my [GetFromRelation] has finally started to take better care of [From.GetHerselfHimself] and is slowly learning how to properly act at court. My [GetFromRelation] has decided to follow my advice and finally change [From.GetHerHis] dieting practices. [From.GetFirstName] looks much more lean and spry already, as a [From.GetManWoman] of [From.GetHerHis] age should.

As the screams of [From.GetTitledFirstName] pour out through the bronze mouth of my bull, turned by its pipes into the bellowing of Hashut himself, I find myself thinking how much I have come to rely on this wonderful instrument, and how much I resemble the first Bull-Tyrants who cast it in the black forges of Zharr-Naggrund...

The Elders still sing of Itzmaya, the First Queen, who led the daughters of Serena out of the drowned cities and bound every warband of Lustria into one sisterhood. Under her rule the tribes were united and at peace.

column1: Of all the lines who have wasted their lives trying to match her, mine has come the closest: Amazonia already answers to my house. Of late I have begun to wonder if the deeds of my family are proof that the spirit of the First Queen is being reborn through our blood, all the way to me.

column2: My house already rules all Amazonia, which gives me a greater claim to the First Queen's legacy than any other [Root.Culture.GetName] ruler. Yet to be acknowledged as Itzmaya reborn, I must submit to the judgment of the wisest among us.

column1: I will summon the eldest and most respected priestesses of Serena and let them examine my life and my character, so that they can confirm to my sisters and subjects what I already know is the truth.

column2: The Elders who have gathered in [Root.Capital.GetName] to judge whether I am worthy to call myself the First Queen reborn say that, before anything else, I must prove my courage to them.

column1: Itzmaya was born the youngest daughter of a minor huntress, yet she showed unmatched bravery all her life, outshining every one of her sisters to rise as a paragon of valor and discipline.
If I truly am the new jaguar of Lustria, it should be easy for me to prove that I have the nerve to match my bold claim.

column2: Months have passed, yet the Elders are still not satisfied with my conduct.

column1: They say I have failed to match the valor of the First Queen, her leadership in battle and her cunning in the hunt.
If I truly am her rebirth, I should not dread facing my enemies or my own doubts.
Until I have proven the purity of my intent, they will not let me move on to the next trial.

column2: Itzmaya's mother may have been a war-leader, but her father was a captive taken in a raid and given to the temple, and she was the last of many daughters.

column1: In time she rose far above her station, outshining her sisters and her mother alike, but the Elders teach that only her humble beginnings let her rule with justice and kindness over every tribe of Lustria, bringing harmony between their many rites and customs.
If I am the First Queen reborn, I must remember the low beginnings of my past life and share her humility.

column2: The Elders are not satisfied with my show of charity.

column1: They say that tossing some gold to the needy is nothing next to the pure heart little Ixa showed when she met the goddess. When the First Queen in her past life had almost nothing, she still shared what little she had with a stranger.
They say my display is hollow by comparison, because everything I give my subjects I will take back in time as their [Root.GetTitle].

column2: It was not easy to convince the Elders, but their answer was inevitable.

column1: It was only a matter of time before my true nature was revealed for all the world to admire.
I am Itzmaya reborn, the First Queen, uniter of the daughters of Serena.
Returning in the form of [Root.GetFullName], I have led my sisters to peace and plenty just as I did in my past life, and just as my daughters will after I leave this body.

column2: After a long and gruelling ordeal, [From.GetTitledFirstName] has been proclaimed by a council of Elders as Itzmaya, the First Queen, born again.

Yet another victim has fallen to my murderous whims. As I look down at the corpse on the floor, I realize that I have managed to stack quite a considerable body count by now. Soon enough, one of my guards brings me back to the matters at hand, asking me what should be done with the remains.

After my most recent victory, I have reunited my most trusted commanders to discuss our future military campaigns. Through my skill and dedication, I have earned the loyalty of my armies and immortalized my name as one of the great conquerors of our time, one who emerged triumphant from countless battles.

Through my considered and cautious leadership, I have been able to maintain my realm at peace, both from external and internal threats, ensuring security and prosperity for all my subjects. Few rulers can claim the same dedication as I have shown, forsaking the lure of conquest to protect their people.

[From.GetFirstName] and I have never been as close as since I convinced my [GetFromRelation] to forsake empty vanity to focus on more concrete responsibilities. The rest of the court might see us as coarse and uncivilized, but we both know better now.

By following my advice, [From.GetFirstName] has become quite the charmer. Maidens that would not have given [From.GetHerHim] a second look before are now filling the palace with their feverish gossiping about my [GetFromRelation]. I have never felt as proud of [From.GetHerHim] before.

Feeling [From.GetFirstName] encroaching on my place at the dinner table, I stick my elbow in [From.GetHerHis] gut, prompting my [GetFromRelation] to raise [From.GetHerHis] head from the plate. [From.GetSheHeCap] proclaims that there soon will not be enough space for both of us in the hall, at which point we both erupt in a bellowing laughter.

Ever since [From.GetFirstName] decided to follow my advice, we have spent much more time together, eschewing the crass excesses of evening dinners for relaxing walks outside and quiet contemplation. My [GetFromRelation] has never looked better, having acquired a much more humble and collected figure, not unlike my own.

I am thoroughly impressed by well my talk with my [GetFromRelation] went. [From.GetFirstName] now fully understands the mutual bounds and responsibilities that bind us together, both in marriage and blood, and has taken on a completely new and inspiring attitude when it comes to upholding the sanctity of our union.
I wish you to take this small trinket, along with all my gratitude for the excellent time we spent together during the last feast.\n[From.GetTitledFirstName]

By following my advice, [From.GetFirstName] has become quite the charmer. Young men that would not have given [From.GetHerHim] a second look before are now hopelessly competing for [From.GetHerHis] favor and attention, following my [GetFromRelation] whenever [From.GetSheHe] goes. I have never felt as proud of [From.GetHerHim] before.

[From.GetFirstName] rests back [From.GetHerHis] head with a sleepy expression, pressing a napkin on [From.GetHerHis] mouth to suppress a belch. I point at the paunch pressing against [From.GetHerHis] dress and comment that, with such commitment to [From.GetHerHis] new diet, my [GetFromRelation] will soon outrank me as the largest member of our family.

Ever since [From.GetFirstName] decided to follow my advice, we have spent much more time together, eschewing the crass excesses of evening dinners for relaxing walks outside and quiet contemplation. My [GetFromRelation] has never looked better, having acquired a much more diaphanous and elegant figure, not unlike my own.

Since [FromFrom.GetTitledFirstName] was roasted alive inside my brazen bull, a strange rumor has spread through the slave pens and forge-temples of [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName]. The priests of Hashut whisper that the cruelty I share with the first Bull-Tyrants of Zharr-Naggrund is no coincidence, and that the Father of Darkness has marked my line as their heir.

column1: If I let this talk spread, the other Sorcerer-Prophets will see a rival who believes himself chosen, and my whole clan may pay for it.

column2: I was shocked to hear what fate [From.GetTitledFirstName] has in store for me. This deranged lunatic plans to lock me inside a brazen bull and cook me alive!

Only a few hours after [From.GetHerHis] unfortunate demise, [From.GetFirstName] has joined [From.GetHerHis] traitorous peers in the main hall, fashionably dressed and propped on the long, dusty table, the vacuous gaze of [From.GetHerHis] corpse staring at the empty plates before [From.GetHerHim].

It appears that my jailer has a particularly terrible fate in store for me. [FromFrom.GetSheHeCap] will have my body embalmed after my death and prop it in [From.GetHerHis] own palace like a macabre puppet to scare off [FromFrom.GetHerHis] enemies.
A few well-placed words, mixed with a bit of bribery and coercion are surely all that is needed to obfuscate the validity of some of the vile rumors that my enemies are spreading about me...
Keeping together this intricate web of lies holding my good reputation is proving to be an increasingly difficult task.
Sometimes I wonder whether my courtiers really believe in the lies I tell them, if I really am as blameless to their eyes as I hope to be, or if instead I am surrounded by smiling enemies.
Keeping all these lies together is quite the challenging task. All this exercise has sharpened my tongue beyond what I thought to be possible.
People are so gullible! They are all but pawns under my control, for me to push and break as I see fit, incapable of seeing the wolf in sheep's clothing as [Root.GetSheHe] walks amongst them.
I cannot do this anymore! No matter how many people I kill, nobody believes to my accusers. Is the world gone insane?
I have grown bored with [plot_target.GetFirstName]. I think the time has come for me to conclude our delightful game and move onto my next victim.

A mysterious stranger has joined me after tonight's feast. Although [From.GetHerHis] voice sounds familiar, I cannot remember if we have met before in the haze of the dinner. We exchange pleasantries for a while, until a strange feeling makes me shiver, and I suddenly realize that we are alone.

The guest chuckles and welcomes me in a forceful embrace. Something stings me. When I push my assailant away, a stream of blood squirts from my side. The murderer tilts [assassin_plot_owner.GetHerHis] head, smiles, and slashes my throat open with a quick cut of [From.GetHerHis] knife.

I isolate [From.GetFirstName] after a dinner feast. I stalk behind my target as [From.GetSheHe] stumbles through the corridors of the palace in a drunken stupor, and catch [From.GetHerHim] in a cold embrace, plunging my blade through [From.GetHerHis] side. As [From.GetSheHe] turns to scream for help, I cut [From.GetHerHis] throat open.

The guest chuckles and welcomes me in a forceful embrace. Something stings me and I instinctively push [assassin_plot_owner.GetHerHim] away, seeing a stream of blood wetting my clothes already. Looking at my assailant's smile, I finally recognize [assassin_plot_owner.GetHerHim] as [assassin_plot_owner.GetTitledFirstName] and scream [assassin_plot_owner.GetHerHis] name.

I isolate [From.GetFirstName] after a dinner feast. I stalk behind my target as [From.GetSheHe] stumbles through the corridors of the palace in a drunken stupor, and catch [From.GetHerHim] in a cold embrace, plunging my blade through [From.GetHerHis] side. Unfortunately, the [From.GetManWoman] recognizes me and screams my name before I can finish [From.GetHerHim].

My sudden moment of panic passes as quickly as it arrived when one of my courtiers call me from the other side of the corridor. I turn back to invite the strange guest to join us in the hall once again, but [assassin_plot_owner.GetSheHe] has vanished without leaving a trace.

Just as I thought I had finally isolated [From.GetFirstName] to perform my art in peace, one of [From.GetHerHis] drunken friends stumbles upon us in the corridors of [Root.Capital.GetName], forcing me to change my plans.

As the guest approaches me with a few comforting words, I notice the dagger [assassin_plot_owner.GetSheHe] is hiding behind [assassin_plot_owner.GetHerHis] back and immediately push [assassin_plot_owner.GetHerHim] away, screaming for my guards. Seeing [assassin_plot_owner.GetHerHis] attempt at murder fail, my assailant flees.

Just as I am about to start my art on [From.GetFirstName], the drunken fool manages to spot my dagger and starts screaming for help. In [From.GetHerHis] desperate counterattack, [From.GetFirstName] manages to wound me, forcing me to abandon my pursuit and flee.

As the guest approaches me with a few comforting words, I notice the dagger [assassin_plot_owner.GetSheHe] is hiding behind [assassin_plot_owner.GetHerHis] back and immediately push [assassin_plot_owner.GetHerHim] on the ground, twisting the blade against [assassin_plot_owner.GetHerHim] and plunging it into [assassin_plot_owner.GetHerHis] chest.

Just as I am about to plunge my dagger through [From.GetHerHis] flesh, [From.GetFirstName] realizes the danger [From.GetSheHe] has gotten [From.GetHerselfHimself] into and reacts with surprising quickness and strength. [From.GetSheHeCap] slams me on the floor and twists my own blade against me, piercing my heart.

A wandering knight has arrived to my court, drawn in by the tales of virtue and bravery surrounding my family name. [invited_character.GetSheHeCap] claims to have traveled far and wide, searching for a liege worth following, and that [invited_character.GetSheHe] wishes to pledge [invited_character.GetHerselfHimself] to my service.

A wandering bard has arrived at my court, drawn in by the great tales of valor and honor surrounding my family name. [invited_character.GetSheHeCap] claims that [invited_character.GetSheHe] wishes to pledge [invited_character.GetHerHis] loyalty to me and sing about the great deeds of my dynasty.

I have received a distraught message from a damsel in need. [From.GetTitledFirstName] is suffering under the yoke of an uncouth [From.Liege.GetManWoman] with no honor. Hearing tales of my family's reputation, [From.GetSheHe] pleads me to offer [From.GetHerHim] my protection.

Dozens of ships have gathered at the shores of [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName], from the most disparate owners: pirates, Sartosan corsairs, adventurers, mercenaries, fishermen... They have not forgotten how I sheltered them from the war fleets of Tilea and the Empire, and have all come to pledge their keels to my war.

Dozens of ships have gathered at the shores of [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName], from the most disparate owners: pirates, Sartosan corsairs, adventurers, mercenaries, fishermen... They have not forgotten how [pirate_bloodline_target.GetTitledFirstName] sheltered their forefathers from the war fleets of Tilea and the Empire, and have all come to pledge their keels to my war.

A few dozen ships have gathered at the shores of [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName], from the most disparate owners: pirates, Sartosan corsairs, adventurers, mercenaries, fishermen... It seems my name still carries weight along the coast. They have all come to pledge their keels to my war.

A few dozen ships have gathered at the shores of [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName], from the most disparate owners: pirates, Sartosan corsairs, adventurers, mercenaries, fishermen... It seems that the name of [pirate_bloodline_target.GetTitledFirstName] still carries weight along the coast. They have all come to pledge their keels to my war.

A few pirate ships have gathered at the shores of [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName]. Their captains have offered their services in the war to come, hoping to repay me for the haven I gave them from the war galleys of the merchant princes.

A few pirate ships have gathered at the shores of [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName]. Their captains have offered their services in the war to come, hoping to repay my family for the haven it gave them from the war galleys of the merchant princes.

Tales of [Root.GetTitledFirstName]'s cruelty have spread far and wide across the lands of [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName], reaching greater and greater height at each new year.The monstrous tyrant of [Root.Capital.GetName] has burned scores of innocent people to satisfy [Root.GetHerHis] whims. \nBelieving [Root.GetHerselfHimself] to be more than a mere mortal, [Root.GetFirstName] proudly flaunts [Root.GetHerHis] disregard for human life, convinced to be far beyond the reach of [Root.GetHerHis] petty subjects.

The [Root.GetOnlyDynastyName] has always known how to properly deal with those that stand in the way of our glorious destiny. [From.GetFirstName]'s charred corpse is nothing but the last example of our power.
You have angered the dragon, proclaims the jailer, dragging me out of my cell with a mocking smirk. "And now you will taste [FromFrom.GetHerHis] flames."

A famous bard named [invited_character.GetFirstName] has arrived to my court, lured by tales of my family's generosity towards all artists and craftsmen. [invited_character.GetSheHeCap] hopes to join my court and offer [invited_character.GetHerHis] services to such an illustrious patron of the art as I am.

A renowned scholar has arrived to my court to request an audience with me. [invited_character.GetSheHeCap] says [invited_character.GetSheHe] has heard tales of how my dynasty has always offered safe haven and patronage to scholars and artists, and that [invited_character.GetSheHe] wishes to pledge [invited_character.GetHerHis] vast metaphysical knowledge to my service.

A mysterious [invited_character.GetManWoman] has reached my court. [invited_character.GetSheHeCap] claims to be a renown scholar from a place far away, who was cast out by [invited_character.GetHerHis] people for [invited_character.GetHerHis] unyielding devotion to knowledge. [invited_character.GetSheHeCap] hopes that a prestigious patron of the arts such as myself would have greater foresight than [invited_character.GetHerHis] previous liege.

A mysterious [invited_character.GetManWoman] has reached my court. [invited_character.GetSheHeCap] claims that [invited_character.GetSheHe] was forced to leave [invited_character.GetHerHis] homeland amidst spurious accusation of witchcraft laid against [invited_character.GetHerHim]. [invited_character.GetSheHeCap] wishes to pledge [invited_character.GetHerselfHimself] to me, hoping that I will show greater foresight than [invited_character.GetHerHis] previous liege.

Thanks to the tireless efforts of the glorious [Root.GetTitledFirstName], the lands of the [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName] have been wrestled from the barbarity and the misery of its dark past, and have been dragged into a new era of clarity and order. 
A new urbanized bureaucratic caste has taken hold of the provinces once held by quarreling warlords, reinvigorating the Imperial Throne with legitimacy and power beyond all expectations.

Ten thousand years of peace and prosperity upon the great [Root.GetOnlyDynastyName] dynasty and its magnificent reformer!

After countless battles, much land has been reclaimed from those green barbarians. After seeing how they slaughter indescriminately, destroy things without regard to consequence, and seem to exist only to make life a living hell for others, you know in your heart that the world would be better off without them.

Everywhere you go the land turns Green. Little uns pop up out of the ground, boys build forts, squigs run freely, and you can krump someone whenever you like. Life is good. You've gotten quite a reputation for your knack, some say you are blessed by Mork, while others say you are blessed by Gork. All you know is that its getting easier and easier to make things Green.

While others might be tempted to exploit powerful artifacts and the land for their own personal gain, you known that there are much more important things in the world. You know that giving in to selfish and worldly temptations leads to the inevitable suffering not only of yourself but as well as those you are responsible for and who look to you for leadership.

Power always comes at a price, and you've found the trick is to get others to pay that price in your stead. It's not going to bother you if it causes trouble for someone else or causes some sort of issue a thousand years from now. You've taken the power you wanted now, today, none of this worrying about the future when all that really exists is the present.

When [Root.GetTitledFirstName] ascended to the throne at such an early age, few in [Root.GetHerHis] court expected [Root.GetHerHim] to last to adulthood.
Yet, in the end, it was [Root.GetHerHis] detractors that did not survive through the [Root.GetTitle]'s childhood.
Under [Root.GetHerHis] cheerful and playful appearance, the child demonstrated an unparalleled ruthlessness in [Root.GetHerHis] rise to power, meticulously eliminating all those that opposed [Root.GetHerHim]. 
Despite having long since shed the illusory semblance of innocence that allowed [Root.GetHerHim] to lure many of [Root.GetHerHis] victims to an untimely end, [Root.GetTitledFirstName] has become infamous throughout the realm for [Root.GetHerHis] sanguinary childhood.

When [Root.GetTitledFirstName] ascended to the throne at such an early age, few in [Root.GetHerHis] court expected [Root.GetHerHim] to last to adulthood.
Yet, in the end, it was [Root.GetHerHis] detractors that did not survive through the [Root.GetTitle]'s childhood.
Under [Root.GetHerHis] cheerful and playful appearance, the child has demonstrated an unparalleled ruthlessness in [Root.GetHerHis] rise to power, meticulously eliminating all those that opposed [Root.GetHerHim]. 
No playmate of [Root.GetHersHis] dares to deny [Root.GetHerHim] a toy, no tutor dares to punish [Root.GetHerHim], dreading the murderous abyss behind [Root.GetFirstName]'s eerie smile.

Far from being the least bit ashamed of [Root.GetHerHis] murderous inclinations, [Root.GetTitledFirstName] has started to openly display [Root.GetHerHis] victims as a warning towards [Root.GetHerHis] enemies. \n[Root.GetSheHeCap] has dedicated an entire wing of [Root.GetHerHis] palace to host the embalmed corpses of [Root.GetHerHis] kills, propped by [Root.GetHerHis] servants around a large table, wearing fancy outfits, immortalized in an ever-expanding feast of death.\nMany travelers have left [Root.Capital.GetName] horrified after a visit through this horrifying room, spreading its infamous tale across the realm.

As unassuming and welcoming as [Root.Capital.GetName]'s palace might look on the outside, few visitors enter it without a heavy feeling of dread clouding their minds.\nThe manor of the [Root.GetTitle] of [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName] has become quite infamous for swallowing its guests without much warning. Nobody has ever found proof of the [Root.GetTitle]'s misdeed, or ever heard [Root.GetHerHim] order an execution, yet all [Root.GetHerHis] enemies have the alarming tendency to disappear in mysterious circumstances and never be heard from ever again...
I was shocked to hear what fate [FromFrom.GetTitledFirstName] has in store for me. This deranged lunatic plans to lock me inside a brazen bull and cook me alive!

It is hard to reconcile [Root.GetTitledFirstName]'s charming reputation as a guest with [Root.GetHerHis] equally notorious thirst for blood.\nTold to be a nightmarish creature of darkness, the [Root.GetLordLady] of [Root.Capital.GetName] stalks [Root.GetHerHis] preys with skill and finesse, gaining their trust and toying with them until [Root.GetHerHis] boredom forces [Root.GetHerHim] to end the suffering of one victim and move to the next.\nProtected by [Root.GetHerHis] rank and power, this repulsive murderer has been able to terrorize [From.GetHerHis] lands for years, becoming infamous throughout the realm.

Few can boast to have accomplished as much as [Root.GetTitledFirstName] has at such a young age as [Root.GetSheHe] did.\nHaving ascended to power while still a child, this prodigious ruler has been able to lead [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName] through a series of astounding victories against its neighboring realms. \nClearly, this child was born for war and conquest, and there is no telling what [Root.GetSheHe] will be able to accomplish during the rest of [Root.GetHerHis] life.

[Root.GetTitledFirstName] has risen as a shining example of knightly virtue that will not soon be forgotten.\nA paragon of gallantry and valor on the battlefield as well as at court, [Root.GetSheHe] is living proof that ruthlessness and deceit are no requirement to excel on the field of battle. With a pure heart filled with the glory of [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName] and an unwavering discipline, tempered by countless battles and tournaments, the [Root.GetTitle] of [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName] has triumphed over [Root.GetHerHis] enemies time and again, inspiring many young [Root.GetMenWomen] to follow in [Root.GetHerHis] footsteps and sing of [From.GetHerHis] legendary feats.

Scarcely any ruler bordering [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName] sleeps well at night, tormented by the dreams of conquest of their terrible neighbor. [Root.GetTitledFirstName] has carved a blood-soaked path through the lands of [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName], earning the fame of a ruthless and fearsome warrior.\n None is safe from [Root.GetHerHis] reach, and it is hard to say if [Root.GetHerHis] thirst for conquest will ever be satisfied. A cunning and relentless commander, [Root.GetSheHe] has overseen countless victories on the battlefield and acquired immortal glory for [Root.GetHerselfHimself] as well as all [Root.GetHerHis] descendants.

By emulating some of the greatest and wisest Kings of old, [Root.GetTitledFirstName] has achieved a perfect balance between wisdom and grit, becoming both a scholar and a warrior, and applying the vast depths of [Root.GetHerHis] knowledge to lead [Root.GetHerHis] armies to countless victories and earn eternal glory for [Root.GetHerHis] dynasty.\nFew people can claim to have accomplished as much as [Root.GetSheHe] has within their lifetime, excelling both in spiritual and political disciplines to such an extent. \n[Root.GetTitledFirstName]'s name will surely be remembered in many legends by future generations as that of a respected and fearsome warrior-philosopher.

With the child having ascended to the throne at such an early age, [Root.GetTitledFirstName]'s inheritance was initially perceived by many as the beginning of a period of instability and fear for the people of [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName]. Instead, the child [Root.GetTitle] ushered a new era of peace and prosperity throughout [Root.GetHerHis] realm, ruling firmly and kindly, and showing a wisdom far beyond [Root.GetHerHis] years.\nMost of [Root.GetHerHis] subjects now praise [Root.GetHerHim] for [Root.GetHerHis] enlightened rule, claiming that [Root.GetSheHe] must have been blessed by [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName].

[From.GetTitledFirstName] is pushed screaming and kicking inside the brazen bull in the middle of the throne room, under the silent watch of all my courtiers. The [From.GetManWoman]'s desperate shrieking as [From.GetSheHe] is roasted alive inside the contraption soon turns into harmonious bellowing.

[Root.GetTitledFirstName] has risen as a symbol of peace and prosperity for all the people of [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName].\nThrough diplomacy and intimidation, [Root.GetSheHe] has managed to maintain [Root.GetHerHis] realm at peace for as long as most people can remember.\n[Root.GetHerHisCap] tireless devotion to the protection of [Root.GetHerHis] subjects has earned [Root.GetHerHim] the respect of many and ensured that [Root.GetHerHis] dynasty will forever be associated with safety and tranquility, and [Root.GetHerHim] as the benevolent [Root.GetFatherMother] of the realm.

[Root.GetTitledFirstName] has risen as a symbol of peace and prosperity for all the people of [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName].\nThrough diplomacy and intimidation, [Root.GetSheHe] has managed to maintain [Root.GetHerHis] realm at peace for as long as most people can remember, enriching both [Root.GetHerselfHimself] as well as [Root.GetHerHis] subjects.\nRather than waste lives and wealth after elusive victories on the field of battle, [Root.GetSheHe] has decided to share [Root.GetHerHis] riches with [Root.GetHerHis] subjects, in an endless cavalcade of feasts and fairs that have earned [Root.GetHerHim] the love and reverence of many people in [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName] and beyond.

Rather than wasting lives and wealth after dreams of new conquest, [Root.GetTitledFirstName] has dedicated [Root.GetHerHis] life to the improvement of [Root.GetHerHis] own realm, founding several new cities during the course of [Root.GetHerHis] reign, strengthening the infrastructure of [Root.GetHerHis] roads and holdings, and improving the living conditions of [Root.GetHerHis] subjects beyond measure.\nThanks to [Root.GetHerHis] efforts, [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName] has grown to be a much more prosperous and populous realm than it would have otherwise been.\nThousands of new settlers will forever remember [Root.GetTitledFirstName]'s vital contribution to the creation of their new homes.

[Root.GetTitledFirstName]'s tireless efforts in the construction of new fortifications aimed at the defense of [Root.GetHerHis] realm have immortalized [Root.GetHerHis] name as an ingenious and considerate planner.\n[Root.GetSheHeCap] has populated many of the hills of [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName] with impregnable embodiments of [Root.GetHerHis] wondrous technological ingenuity, projecting a sense of safety to all [Root.GetHerHis] subjects.\nFor some time now, [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName] has acquired a reputation as a realm of towers and stone walls, secure from even the wildest horde.

In an unparalleled show of devotion, [Root.GetTitledFirstName] has dedicated [Root.GetHerHis] life to the construction of sacred monuments honoring the glory of [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName].\nScarcely any town within [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName] is beyond walking distance from a sanctuary of some sort, and every major city in the realm has come to host the majestic sight of a great temple.\nSeveral members of the clergy have celebrated [Root.GetTitledFirstName]'s virtuous projects on multiple occasions, and the [Root.GetTitle] has become a symbol of craftsmanship dedicated to heavenly pursuit.

[Root.GetTitledFirstName]'s name has become synonymous with war and mayhem.\nDriven by an insatiable thirst for blood and conquest, this [Root.GetManWoman] is said to possess both the ferocity of a lion and the cunning of a fox, pursuing [Root.GetHerHis] mad ambitions with no concern for mercy and honor.\n[Root.GetHerHisCap] infamous exploits and the vile tactics with which [Root.GetSheHe] has achieved many victories on the field have stained [Root.GetHerHis] dynasty forever.

Through [Root.GetHerHis] just and considerate rule, [Root.GetTitledFirstName] has managed to maintain [Root.GetHerHis] realm in a state of peace and prosperity for several years.\nDespite being a distant and cold ruler, the [Root.GetTitle] of [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName] has had a reign surprisingly devoid of malignant rumors or dissident factions.\nMost people assume that this is but the natural consequence of a wise [Root.GetManWoman] being in charge, yet an unspoken sense of uneasiness appears to loom over the people of [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName]...

A patron of the crafts, [Root.GetTitledFirstName] has brought unparalleled fame to [Root.GetHerHis] family with [Root.GetHerHis] unfettered patronage of countless enterprises, overseeing the construction of new temples, castles and entire cities all across [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName].\nThanks to [Root.GetHerHis] wise investments, the realm's wealth has been increased beyond measure, and for this [Root.GetSheHe] is sure to be remembered for generations to come.

Sacrifices must be made when creating something great.
No one more than [Root.GetTitledFirstName] has exemplified this concept during the course of [Root.GetHerHis] bloodied realm.
The [Root.GetTitle] of [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName] is celebrated as the founder of many marvels of modern architecture, yet [Root.GetSheHe] is also associated with several violent deaths and sinister plots.
It has become a common saying for the people of [Root.Capital.GetName] that any new building ordered by the [Root.GetTitle] is yet another tomb where [Root.GetSheHe] will hide the remains of [Root.GetHerHis] next victim.

The guards drag me out of the dungeon and to [FromFrom.GetTitledFirstName]'s court. My hopes for freedom vanish quickly as I see the imposing figure of the brass bull staring at me from the middle of the hall, surrounded by fearful courtiers. The guards drag me towards the statue while the executioner starts stoking the fires beneath it.

While avoiding being forgotten entirely is my primary concern, it is also equally important for me to think about how I actually do wish posterity to think of me. How can I make sure that when I die, future generations will speak in awe and wonder about my accomplishments as [Root.GetTitle], and feel inspired to emulate me?
It is clear that only by cultivating an impeccable reputation I will be able to make the memory of my name stand the test of time.
In order to immortalize my name I must leave an indelible mark on [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName], improving my realm beyond what even my predecessors dared to accomplish...
Only through decisive action and by achieving complete control over my realm I will be able to immortalize my name for centuries to come.

It has come to my attention that many of the realm's laws handling petty disputes are old and obsolete. Revising our legal system to provide fair and satisfying judgment will certainly improve the conditions of my subjects and increase the prestige of my dynasty.

The great legal reform of [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName] is finally reaching its conclusion, yet new issues seem to have stemmed by my undertaking. There is a growing concern amongst the nobility that these new laws are too lax and might encourage peasants to avoid their responsibilities and acquire seditious tendencies.

By revolutionizing the legal system of [Root.GetHerHis] realm, [Root.GetTitledFirstName] has enshrined [Root.GetHerHis] name as that of a wise and benevolent ruler, ready to hear the plight of [Root.GetHerHis] subjects and administer justice with a firm but gentle hand.\n[Root.GetHerHisCap] dedication to equity and virtue have undoubtedly ensured [Root.GetHerHim] a place by [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName]'s side and earned [Root.GetHerHis] dynasty a spot in history.
Foul rumors are spreading from Zharr-Naggrund. The Tower of Gorgoth is in the hands of a cruel [From.GetManWoman] who claims to be a descendant of the Bull-Tyrants of old.

column1: Consumed by paranoid delusions and sadistic fantasies, [From.GetSheHe] has killed hundreds of [From.GetHerHis] own slaves and subjects for the most trivial of slights.
Most of [From.GetHerHis] victims have met their end in the fiery belly of [From.GetHerHis] brazen bull, the sacred beast of [From.GetHerHis] dark god Hashut.

column2: It has come to my attention that several old laws issued by less forward-thinking rulers than I are still plaguing the judicial system of our realm, imposing undue limitations to my authority as [Root.GetTitle]. How am I supposed to accomplish anything worthy of note when I am bound by the leftovers of a time long since forgotten?

Ever since I started my legal reform, I have had an increasing series of people, petty noblemen and peasants alike, pestering me about the changes I am making to our laws. They claim that the reform is motivated by selfish motives, that I only wish to accumulate power and tyrannize over my subjects.
Personally attempt to assassinate §Y[plot_target.GetTitledFirstName]§!
We were once like them, we should not judge their ways.
I shall strive to be more like [target_bloodline_founder.GetHerHim]!
If the slaves cannot love me, they will learn to fear me. Hashut demands it.
No! Get away from me!
Do you want to play a very special game, [scoped_guardian.GetFirstName]?
Careful, child, you might get hurt.
Ugh... Stupid grownup.
Such a tragically fortuitous accident...
I wonder if..?
What a charming new guest we have!
What!?! That is insane!
I would never raise a hand against my kin!
So many things to remember...
What are they thinking?

Wherever I go, all eyes are upon me. One [sex_partner.GetManWoman] in particular stands out – [sex_partner.GetSheHe] is stunningly [sex_partner.GetBeautifulHandsome], and looks at me with such hunger in [sex_partner.GetHerHis] eyes... Perhaps I should encourage [sex_partner.GetHerHim]?
Join me in my [child_of_destiny.GetChamber] for some... [child_of_destiny.GetAlcohol]?
I have more important matters to attend to...

In order to teach me how to hunt, [marshal_target.GetJobTitle] [marshal_target.GetFirstName] has brought me into the forest. We are silently moving through the shrubbery as I spot a [child_of_destiny.GetRegionalSmallGameAnimal]! I give chase, running until I manage to get a clear shot off – it is a kill! I turn around to face [marshal_target.GetFirstName] with a gleeful smile on my face, but in [marshal_target.GetHerHis] stead is a massive [child_of_destiny.GetRegionalFerociousAnimal]! I ready my spear, and then I...
... use a rock as leverage and puncture the neck of the [child_of_destiny.GetRegionalFerociousAnimal] as it attacks!
... run towards the nearby cliff and feint the [child_of_destiny.GetRegionalFerociousAnimal] so it falls off!

I am awestruck when I see what [marshal_target.GetJobTitle] [marshal_target.GetFirstName] and [child_of_destiny.GetFirstName] has brought back from their hunt. A trophy from a massive [child_of_destiny.GetRegionalFerociousAnimal]! I thought they were hunting for [child_of_destiny.GetRegionalSmallGameAnimal]... [marshal_target.GetFirstName] ensures me that [marshal_target.GetSheHe] and [child_of_destiny.GetFirstName] tracked the [child_of_destiny.GetRegionalFerociousAnimal] together, and that [marshal_target.GetSheHe] absolutely did not lose track of where [child_of_destiny.GetFirstName] was, only arriving after the [child_of_destiny.GetRegionalFerociousAnimal] was already dead...
What? How can this be? Sounds highly suspect...
Unbelievable!

Horrible news! While out hunting with [marshal_target.GetJobTitle] [marshal_target.GetFirstName], [child_of_destiny.GetFirstName] was killed by a massive [child_of_destiny.GetRegionalFerociousAnimal]! According to [marshal_target.GetJobTitle] [marshal_target.GetFirstName] the beast came out of nowhere and devoured [child_of_destiny.GetFirstName] in one big gulp, before turning on [marshal_target.GetHerHim] and chasing [marshal_target.GetHerHim] out of the forest...

The time has come. My blood burns with ambition, I can stay idle no longer! It is my destiny to become [child_of_destiny.GetKingQueen], and I have the support I need to realize it! My eyes are set upon [target_invasion_character.PrimaryTitle.GetName], and all the riches that lie within...

My blood burns with ambition, I can stay idle no longer! It is my destiny to become [child_of_destiny.GetKingQueen], and I have the support I need to realize it! Just one question remains, should I focus my ambition inwards, or outwards? Should I stay and fight for the throne of [top_liege_match_target.PrimaryTitle.GetName], or should I abandon my past and look towards [target_invasion_character.PrimaryTitle.GetName]?
My destiny is to rule [top_liege_match_target.PrimaryTitle.GetName]!
I shall lead my armies towards [target_invasion_character.PrimaryTitle.GetName]!
The time is not right... I will give it more time.

I always expected [child_of_destiny.GetFirstName] to do this, though I hoped the day would never come... [child_of_destiny.GetSheHeCap] has, with popular support, laid claim to [top_liege_match_target.PrimaryTitle.GetName]! With a massive host of willing soldiers backing [child_of_destiny.GetHerHis] claim, I fear it will not be long before a civil war breaks out...
Please, [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName], make my [child_of_destiny.GetSonDaughter] see reason...
Oh [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName], [child_of_destiny.GetHerHis] ambition will ruin us all!

It seems as if [child_of_destiny.GetFirstName] has decided that [child_of_destiny.GetHerHis] ambitions will never be realized as long as [child_of_destiny.GetSheHe] stays in [top_liege_match_target.PrimaryTitle.GetName]. [child_of_destiny.GetSheHeCap] has attracted a massive host of eager soldiers, willing to fight and die for [child_of_destiny.GetHerHim], which he is steering towards the realm of [target_invasion_character.GetFullName]. I fear [target_invasion_character.PrimaryTitle.GetName] is doomed...
This is the last drop, [child_of_destiny.GetFirstName] is out of the will!
What a relief! Now [child_of_destiny.GetFirstName] is [target_invasion_character.GetFirstName]s problem!

Lately my thoughts have been shaded by dark clouds. Today I read a book about an ancient champion, and [child_of_destiny.GetSheHe] reminds me of myself! [child_of_destiny.GetSheHeCap] fights impossible odds, and overcomes hardships similar to my own. It is as if the champion of the book and myself share a destiny! I must not doubt myself, this world will be mine one day.
Beware, darkness - for I shall banish you from my mind!

My natural charisma has led me to become very popular. Other kids do not dare to pick on me, as I have many friends who would come to my aid at a moments notice. In fact, there is always someone following me around. Whatever I want them to do, they will do for me – in the playground, I rule.
When I am [child_of_destiny.GetKingQueen], loyalty will be rewarded.
They say they would die for me, I like that!

[child_of_destiny.GetFirstName] seems to be very charismatic – in the playground [child_of_destiny.GetSheHe] is always 'guarded' by at least three other children. It would almost seem as if [child_of_destiny.GetSheHe] is building the foundation of a very young army...
I am glad that my [child_of_destiny.GetSonDaughter] is making friends, I suppose?
Ominous, children should not act like this...

I thought I was going to rot in prison forever, until I heard a voice outside my cell. "Be very silent, I am getting you out of here!" the voice whispers. It is [savior_target.GetFullName], come to save me!
Let us escape from here!
No, I quite like it here.

During the night, [child_of_destiny.GetFullName] escaped from my dungeons! [child_of_destiny.GetSheHeCap] was apparently helped by [savior_target.GetFullName], who has joined [child_of_destiny.GetHerHim] at [child_of_destiny.GetHerHis] court.
Preposterous!

[child_of_destiny.GetFullName], who was imprisoned by [jailer_target.GetFullName], has escaped during the night! [child_of_destiny.GetSheHeCap] was apparently helped by [savior_target.GetFullName], who has joined [child_of_destiny.GetHerHis] court.
Huh, impressive!

I know that the key to success lies in who I let close to me. No great [child_of_destiny.GetManWoman] ever reached the top without having at least a couple of loyal friends by their side – and I intend to choose only the most useful of people to stand by my side. There are many people clamoring for my attention, but who should I encourage?
Someone powerful, to aid me if I need help.
Someone in a position to further my goals...
Someone wise and clever, to provide counsel.
I do not like either of these people.

It all went very fast. [child_of_destiny.GetFirstName], famous as [child_of_destiny.GetSheHe] is, has had no trouble amassing a vast host of eager warriors. With [child_of_destiny.GetHerHis] eyes set upon the realm of [target_character.GetFullName] they now embark on their adventure, without so much as a farewell. There truly were no way controlling the ambition of that [child_of_destiny.GetBoyGirl]...
I hope my [child_of_destiny.GetDaughterSon] does not forget about me...
The audacity of that [child_of_destiny.GetManWoman]!

The time has finally come! I have left the shackles of childhood behind me, ready to seize my destiny. As a [child_of_destiny.GetManWoman] I am free to forge my own path, and the path I intend to forge is paved with my unbridled ambition. Beware, world, for I am here to tame you.
Thus it begins!

After having survived a childhood more perilous than those of most old stories, [child_of_destiny.GetFirstName] has grown into a magnificent young [child_of_destiny.GetManWoman]. Having shown nothing but promise throughout [child_of_destiny.GetHerHis] entire upbringing, [child_of_destiny.GetSheHe] has eclipsed all of [child_of_destiny.GetHerHis] teachers and become a masterful strategist.
My dear [child_of_destiny.GetDaughterSon], is it not time to rest for a while now?
I dare not think what [child_of_destiny.GetSheHe] is getting up to...
Finally, [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName] is mine! Now, how do I wish to rule over my new subjects? Should I impose my beliefs and traditions upon them, or should I adapt to their culture and morals?
I shall adopt both their traditions and faith!
I will adopt their traditions, but I will not abandon [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName].
Their faith speaks to me... adopting it could further my plans.
I will not change, they will have to get used to me!

Ever since I was a child I dreamt about this moment, to seize a crown and name myself [Root.GetTitle], and now it has finally come true! But my ambitions know no bounds – for as long as I live, I shall conquer. My name shall be known across the world, and my legacy will last for millennia!
I have seized my destiny, though it does not end here!

A great conqueror by the name of [child_of_destiny.GetFirstNameWithNick] has invaded and taken over the realm of [child_of_destiny.PrimaryTitle.GetName]. [child_of_destiny.GetSheHeCap] is a [child_of_destiny.GetManWoman] of unrivaled ambition, with eyes set on the rest of the known world. Time will tell if [child_of_destiny.GetSheHe] will build an empire to rival that of Alexander the Great himself, or if [child_of_destiny.GetSheHe] will march [child_of_destiny.GetHerHis] army into oblivion in the Gedrosian desert...
May [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName] help us all...
[child_of_destiny.GetFirstName] the Great

Lying in my bed I glance out through the open window. In the stars I can see my destiny, the soft light dancing in front of my eyes – telling of the many adventures I will have, the friends I will make, and the Kingdoms I will rule. It is comforting to know that the stars align just for me.
When I am older I will seize what is mine, but for now I will rest.
As the Grand Theogonist crowns the Emperor in Sigmar's name, so the Temple can take that blessing back.
